chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Isma'il ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from Abu al-Maghra', from Sama'a, from Abu al-Hassan Musa (AS), who said:

I said to him (AS), 'Is everything in the Book of God and the Sunnah of His Prophet (SAWW), or do you (Imams) also give opinions about it?' He (AS) said, 'Rather, everything is in the Book of God and the Sunnah of His Prophet (SAWW).'

key_terms.بَلْ: rather/nay — corrective emphatic particle affirming the positive contrary
key_terms.سُنَّةِ نَبِيِّهِ: the Sunnah of His Prophet — the prophetic traditions, the secondary revealed source
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: the Book of God — the Quran, the primary revealed source

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) say when asked whether everything is in the Quran and Sunnah or whether the Imams add independent opinions?
ai.summary: Sama'a ibn Mihran questions Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) as to whether all matters are entirely contained within the Quran and the prophetic Sunnah, or whether the Imams additionally put forward independent opinions. The Imam responds with the emphatic corrective particle 'بَلْ' (rather/nay), categorically affirming that everything is in the Book of God and the Sunnah — rejecting any notion of Imami opinion as an autonomous legal source separate from revelation and establishing the comprehensive sufficiency of the two primary sources.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abu Magra’a, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is everything in the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Sunnah of His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, or are you<sup>asws</sup> (Imams<sup>asws</sup>) are saying with regards to it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, everything is in the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Sunnah from His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn Ni‘man from ’Isma‘il ibn Jabir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“In the book of Allah there is the news of things before you, the reports of the matters after you and the laws to settle your disputes and we know it all.”
